vastu_fact_1: Did you know? The NE corner (Ishanya) is considered the most sacred zone in Vastu.
vastu_fact_2: Vastu Shastra is over 5,000 years old, originating from the Sthapatya Veda.
vastu_fact_3: The main entrance is the single most important factor in Vastu alignment.
vastu_fact_4: The SE corner (Agni kon) represents the fire element — ideal for kitchens.
vastu_fact_5: The SW zone represents stability and relationships — perfect for the master bedroom.
